title: RoofedOff
description: This mod adds the bedrock roof from mcsm season 2 to the overworld, simply just that. No yeast no eggs and no butter, just a roof and a light level of 0
body:
This mod adds a bedrock roof, yeah you WILL spawn above the roof but i dunno how to fix that im making this with mcreator and a dream.
For modpacks i guess, its kinda useless otherwise
its not very fancy, just one structure repeated forever.
